name: Theo thUSD
oneLiner: thUSD is Theo's dollar stablecoin, minted and redeemed 1:1 in USDC or USDT by whitelisted parties and backed by a delta-neutral gold carry trade and thBILL.
collateral: Delta-neutral gold carry position (long leased physical gold, short CME gold futures, Treasury-bill margin) plus thBILL tokenized Treasuries and USDC/USDT redemption liquidity; per the live transparency dashboard the reserve is roughly three-quarters gold carry and one-quarter thBILL
pegMechanism: Nominal 1:1 mint and redemption against USDC or USDT through ThUSDMinter using depositor-signed EIP-712 orders quoted by Theo and submitted by the privileged minter, with whitelist checks, per-block caps and one-sided on-chain amount checks (a mint never issues more thUSD than the collateral deposited, and a redemption never pays out more collateral than the thUSD burned); redemption is subject to a fee and available collateral in the Cash Wallet. Backing is deployed into gold carry, thBILL and stablecoin liquidity; yield accrues to sthUSD stakers, not thUSD holders. Secondary liquidity is concentrated in an Ethereum Uniswap v4 thUSD/USDC pool.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: thUSD is minted 1:1 against USDC/USDT, but the backing is deployed into a managed delta-neutral position: long leased physical gold (including through the MG999 fund) hedged by short CME gold futures with T-bill margin, supplemented by thBILL and stablecoin liquidity. The hedged short-futures structure matches the synthetic-delta-neutral archetype that drives the hedged-position schematic even though the long leg is commodity RWA rather than crypto collateral.
